newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to fund social programs out of oil revs.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to fund social programs out of oil revs.

text.p: The Venezuelan government believes that it will no longer be necessary to use loans from the multilateral agencies to fund its social programs, Family Minister Carlos Altimari said.
With Venezuelan enjoying windfall oil revenues, "social programmes will be financed out of the national budget," he told reporters after the weekly cabinet meeting.

Altimari denied the Inter American Development Bank (IADB) had recommended a major restructuring of Venezuela's current 250 billion bolivar ($531 million) social spending. But he acknowledged some of the government's programs would be cut short.
Social spending is seen flat in nominal terms for next year, he added, at 400 billion bolivars ($851 million).
